note: Plain-language meaning and risk of every permission an extension can ask for. Shown in the store and the developer docs; the app's own check (ExtensionManifest.kt) is the authority on what is allowed.

permissions.label: Read what you type
permissions.summary: Can read the text you are typing in the current field, only when you tap one of its buttons.

permissions.label: Use the clipboard
permissions.summary: Can read or write the clipboard when you tap one of its buttons.

permissions.label: Write to a folder you choose
permissions.summary: Can create files in one folder that you pick. It cannot see anything else on the device.

permissions.label: Show word suggestions on the keys
permissions.summary: Can draw Clackpad's own predicted words on the fret bars. It never sees what you type.

permissions.label: Open web links
permissions.summary: Can open web links in your browser.

permissions.label: Start an email
permissions.summary: Can open your email app with a draft.

permissions.label: Talk to one website
permissions.summary: Can send data to the named website (the host is shown next to it) when you tap one of its buttons.
